name: Tokyo Transparent Toilet

designer.name: Shigeru Ban
designer.bio: Pritzker Prize–winning architect known for innovative use of materials and humanitarian design. His work balances beauty, functionality, and social impact.

tagline: Color-shifting glass turns opaque when occupied.
description: In Shibuya's Yoyogi Fukamachi Mini Park, Shigeru Ban reimagined the public toilet as an experiment in transparency and trust. Glass walls remain clear from the outside, but switch to an opaque state when locked—protecting privacy while inviting openness. More than a convenience, it's a gentle nudge toward empathy and better public spaces.

images.caption: The transparent stalls in Yoyogi Fukamachi Park glow softly at dusk.

images.alt: Looking inside one of the colored glass stalls
images.caption: Interior view from within a vacant stall.
After sunset, the structure becomes a soft lantern in the park.

images.alt: Close-up of the smart glass mechanism
images.caption: Close-up of the electrochromic glass detail.

images.alt: The toilet in its park context, surrounded by greenery
images.caption: The wider context — a quiet pocket park in Shibuya.
A wider view showing the full footprint.

visitorTips.title: Best Time to Visit
visitorTips.description: Visit in the morning or late afternoon for softer light and fewer crowds.

visitorTips.title: Privacy
visitorTips.description: Glass walls turn opaque automatically when the door is locked.

visitorTips.title: Accessibility
visitorTips.description: Step-free access and spacious interior. Accessible for all visitors.

visitorTips.title: Nearby Context
visitorTips.description: Located in Yoyogi Fukamachi Mini Park, a peaceful green pocket in Shibuya.

name: Cliffside Toilet at Cape Royal
tagline: A dramatic restroom perched above canyon vistas.
description: Tucked steps away from one of the Grand Canyon's most expansive North Rim viewpoints, this unassuming vault toilet offers something most architectural marvels cannot: a panorama that stretches for miles. Built for utility but framed by raw geology, it's a quiet reminder that the most memorable comforts often come without plumbing.

images.alt: Vault toilet near the Cape Royal viewpoint on the Grand Canyon's North Rim
images.caption: A pit stop with one of the widest views in the American Southwest.

images.alt: The canyon view from near the toilet
images.caption: The canyon panorama just steps away.
Late afternoon light along the rim.

images.alt: The trail leading to the toilet
images.caption: The short path from the parking area.

visitorTips.title: Best Time to Visit
visitorTips.description: Sunrise and sunset cast the most dramatic light across the canyon.

visitorTips.title: Practical Tips
visitorTips.description: Vault toilet — no running water. Bring hand sanitizer and pack out all trash.

visitorTips.title: Accessibility
visitorTips.description: Ground-level entry; the surrounding terrain is uneven and exposed.

visitorTips.title: Nearby Context
visitorTips.description: Right beside the Cape Royal viewpoint on the North Rim's scenic drive.

name: The Loo at Trafalgar Square
tagline: A Victorian-flavored convenience beneath the square.
description: A small civic refuge tucked beneath one of London's most photographed landmarks. Among streams of tourists, double-deckers and Trafalgar's lions, this modest public loo carries on a long London tradition of dignified, accessible public conveniences hidden in plain sight.

images.alt: Public toilet entrance near Trafalgar Square in central London
images.caption: Just steps from the lions, a quiet civic refuge in central London.
Trafalgar Square seen from the entrance.
A short walk from Charing Cross station.

visitorTips.title: Best Time to Visit
visitorTips.description: Off-peak afternoons avoid the busiest tourist hours.

visitorTips.title: Nearby Context
visitorTips.description: A short walk from Charing Cross station and the National Gallery.

visitorTips.title: Accessibility
visitorTips.description: Step-free access; centrally located for visitors with mobility needs.

visitorTips.title: What to Expect
visitorTips.description: A small fee may apply during peak hours; queues are common at midday.
